# acadrust 0.6.8

Unmodified native dependency, MPL-2.0. SpacePreview calls its public reader and DXF writer APIs.

Corresponding source: https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/acadrust/0.6.8/download

Project: https://github.com/hakanaktt/acadrust

Rebuild with `cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked`.
The package checksum and dependency version are pinned in src-tauri/Cargo.lock.
